subject: english
stem: Bring your own cup to Green Cafe this Friday. Each reusable cup keeps one plastic cup out of the waste bin. Why was this message written?
options: to encourage customers to bring reusable cups
to explain how plastic cups are made
to entertain readers with a cafe story

optionRationales.reason: to encourage customers to bring reusable cups：命令 Bring 與減廢理由共同形成行動呼籲。
to explain how plastic cups are made：沒有製造步驟。
to report Friday's sales：沒有銷售數據。
to entertain readers with a cafe story：沒有故事情節。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文體、內容安排與讀者預期行動共同指向的寫作目的」可推出 to encourage customers to bring reusable cups；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 to encourage customers to bring reusable cups 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
